concerns.location: plan.md:Section II Technical Context / Phase 2 I04 (Domain bias handling)
concerns.text: The plan’s Phase 2 I04 references a `source_domain` field for bias handling, but the `ABSummary` entity defined in data-model.md does not include a `source_domain` attribute. This creates a mismatch between the plan (which expects domain information) and the data model (which lacks it). Either add `source_domain` (and related timestamp fields) to the `ABSummary` definition in data-model.md or adjust the plan to compute domain bias using a separate metadata structure.
